title: Custom Football Players and Large Football Close Comforter
description:
Transform your bedroom into the ultimate sports haven with the Custom Football Art Comforter from Jeminise. Perfect for football players, fans, and teams, this bedding set features a cool graphic illustration of football players with a large football close-up. Whether you choose the lightweight duvet cover or the cozy comforter option, this bedding adds a dynamic, athletic touch to any space, making it a thoughtful custom gift for holidays or birthdays.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Features two custom text inputs to personalize your sports-themed bedding.
  • Two Bedding Options: Choose between a lightweight, easy-to-wash Duvet Cover with a hidden zipper closure or a thicker, cozy Comforter with warm microfiber filling.
  • Premium Material: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester microfiber fabric for a soft, breathable, and durable feel.
  • Available Sizes: Perfectly sized for US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Included Components: Each package comes with 1 Duvet Cover or Comforter, with optional matching pillowcases and flat sheet covers.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; tumble dry on low heat for quick, fluffy drying.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Selected Design Football Art
Theme Football
Style Contemporary
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine wash with cold water, Tumble dry on low heat, Iron on low/medium heat
